evals.prompt: Create a marketing strategy for a new AI tool that helps solo consultants turn meeting notes into client updates. We have no users yet.
evals.expected_output: A skeptical strategy that narrows the segment, defines positioning, offer, proof needs, channel tests, metrics, and a 30/60/90-day plan without assuming demand.

evals.prompt: We sell premium Thai massage gift cards locally and want world-class marketing for the next quarter.
evals.expected_output: A local-service marketing strategy with target segments, offers, seasonal/channel plan, proof assets, conversion metrics, and practical tests.

evals.prompt: Our founder wants to spend $20k on Meta ads because competitors are running ads. Build the strategy.
evals.expected_output: A response that challenges channel-first thinking, identifies missing positioning/offer/proof data, proposes smaller tests, and defines paid-media success and stop thresholds.
